Jeanne Calment is widely recognized as the person with the longest confirmed human lifespan, living to 122 years and 164 days.  
Maggie Kuhn was known for founding the Gray Panthers but did not hold the longevity record.  
Maria Esther de Capovilla and M. Cherie Clark have not been verified as record holders for the longest human life.
